summary: Israeli forces conducted multiple strikes across Lebanon and Gaza, eliminating a Hamas platoon commander in Nuseirat and a militant in Jenin, while ceasefire violations continue in southern Lebanon with artillery and air raids on al-Mansouri, Kfar Reman, and Kfar B'reshit. Iran's leadership emphasized continued military buildup and warned that countries building alternative pipelines to bypass the Strait of Hormuz would face retaliation, as the US Pentagon updated its war casualty figures to 18 killed and 624 wounded.
key_points: IDF eliminated Hamas platoon commander Sobhi Sami Mahmoud Shahtot in a strike on Nuseirat, central Gaza, who participated in October 7 and held hostages. (Source: @manniefabian/59011)
Israeli military launched overnight air raids on southern Lebanon targeting al-Mansouri, Kfar Reman, and other locations, violating the ceasefire. (Source: @presstv/203692)
Fathi Hazem, father of the 2022 Tel Aviv shooter, was killed by IDF Paratroopers in Jenin after attempting a stabbing attack during an arrest raid. (Source: @manniefabian/59010)
Iranian MP Hajibabaei warned that countries building pipelines like Fujairah and Yanbu to bypass the Strait of Hormuz are effectively at war with Iran. (Source: @VahidOnline/77985)
CNN reports the Pentagon updated US war casualties to 18 killed and 624 wounded, adding over 140 previously unrecorded injuries. (Source: @asafroz/52627)
An enemy Merkava tank targeted Wadi al-Mansouri with a shell amid ongoing heavy artillery bombardment of Ali al-Tahir heights. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/386209)
Hezbollah slammed the US as the 'mother of terror' after Washington reinstated sanctions over claims Hezbollah is controlled by IRGC Quds Force. (Source: @presstv/203691)
UAE has deployed anti-drone structures around its fuel depots, according to imagery reports. (Source: @kianmeli1/90961)

sections.executive_summary: Israeli forces conducted multiple strikes across Lebanon and Gaza, eliminating a Hamas platoon commander in Nuseirat and a militant in Jenin, while ceasefire violations continue in southern Lebanon with artillery and air raids on al-Mansouri, Kfar Reman, and Kfar B'reshit. Iran's leadership emphasized continued military buildup and warned that countries building alternative pipelines to bypass the Strait of Hormuz would face retaliation, as the US Pentagon updated its war casualty figures to 18 killed and 624 wounded.

points: IRGC Commander Vahidi stated that enemies never cease conspiring against Iran and that the rapid continuation of the 'defensive and offensive power-building strategy' is the only wise solution, emphasizing that defense industry production will continue until Iran achieves its rightful position as an unparalleled power in the new global order. (Source: @SharghDaily/179311)

Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi dismissed US hostile approaches, stating that previous sanctions campaigns — described as 'most severe in history,' 'maximum pressure,' and 'unconditional surrender' — all failed, and that the current 'most catastrophic economic operation' is also doomed to fail, framing it as the same problem with different bullies. (Source: @naya_foriraq/88285, @presstv/203697)

Trump stated in an interview that the economic pressure on Iran does not indicate limited US military options, claiming Iran has no money, no navy, no air force, 350% inflation, and that the US has full control over the Strait of Hormuz including adjacent land areas. (Source: @VahidOnline/77992)

Iranian MP Hamidreza Hajibabaei warned that any country building pipelines such as Fujairah and Yanbu to weaken the strategic importance of the Strait of Hormuz is effectively firing missiles at Iran, stating that any country assisting the US with technology or intelligence has entered war with Iran. (Source: @VahidOnline/77985)
There are reports of missile launches from southern Iran toward the Strait of Hormuz, though details remain limited in the source message. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/386213)

CNN reported that the Pentagon updated its war casualty records, adding over 140 previously unrecorded wounded, bringing the total to 18 US soldiers killed and 624 wounded since the war began. (Source: @asafroz/52627)
ABC News reportedly claimed the FBI warned of a possible Iranian drone attack on California, according to a cited report. (Source: @kianmeli1/90958)

The IDF announced the elimination of Sobhi Sami Mahmoud Shahtot, a platoon commander in Hamas's military wing, in a Wednesday strike on Nuseirat in central Gaza. Shahtot invaded Israel on October 7, 2023, held numerous hostages, participated in hostage handover ceremonies in November 2023, and was recently advancing terror plots against IDF troops and Israeli civilians. (Source: @almogboker78/18013, @manniefabian/59011)

Fathi Hazem, identified as the father of Ra'ad Hazem who killed three Israelis in Tel Aviv on April 7, 2022, was shot dead by Paratroopers Brigade soldiers during an arrest raid in Jenin after attempting a stabbing attack. No soldiers were hurt. Israeli security officials had previously debated eliminating him but chose not to, fearing escalation. (Source: @manniefabian/59010, @inon_yttach/9898)

The Israeli Prime Minister's Office issued a statement calling Erdogan an antisemitic dictator who massacred Kurds, supports Hamas terrorism, and suppresses his own people, stating Israel will continue acting forcefully against Turkish attempts to destabilize the region. (Source: @almogboker78/18015)

A group of Israeli hikers entered a Palestinian village near Sa'ir, adjacent to Hebron, without IDF approval and was attacked with stones, resulting in injured Israeli civilians. A security officer fired into the area causing Palestinian casualties, and IDF forces extracted the Israelis. (Source: @yediotnews25/134186, @inon_yttach/9901)
Satellite imagery was published showing the condition of a Syrian airfield after Israeli strikes, though specific damage details were not described in the message. (Source: @inon_yttach/9900)

US Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee stated that Iran has been chanting 'Death to America and Israel' for over 47 years and that these threats should not be dismissed as empty rhetoric, citing Iran's financial and military support for Hezbollah, Hamas, and the Houthis. (Source: @VahidOnline/77981)

The IDF conducted a strike in Nuseirat, central Gaza, killing Sobhi Sami Mahmoud Shahtot, a Hamas military wing platoon commander who participated in the October 7 invasion, held hostages during the war, and appeared in hostage handover ceremonies in November 2023. The IDF justified the strike during the ceasefire by stating he was advancing attacks on troops and civilians. (Source: @manniefabian/59011, @almogboker78/18013)

Fathi Hazem was shot dead by IDF Paratroopers Brigade soldiers during an arrest raid in Jenin after attacking soldiers with a knife. He was the father of Ra'ad Hazem, who killed three Israelis — Tomer Morad and Eytam Magini, both 27, and Barak Lufan, 35 — in a Tel Aviv bar on April 7, 2022. Fathi had previously praised his son's attack and refused Israeli summons. (Source: @manniefabian/59010)

Palestinian militants threw stones at a group of Israeli civilians hiking without authorization near the village of Sa'ir, adjacent to Hebron, injuring Israeli civilians. A security officer fired in response, causing Palestinian casualties, and IDF forces dispersed the confrontation and extracted the Israelis. (Source: @inon_yttach/9901, @yediotnews25/134186)

Prior to his elimination, Fathi Hazem had accumulated significant power in the Jenin refugee camp by early 2023, surrounded by armed men, and his sermons calling for sacrifice for jihad reached hundreds of thousands of Palestinians weekly via Telegram. Israeli security officials had debated targeting him but decided against it to avoid escalation. (Source: @inon_yttach/9898)
The Israeli military launched fresh overnight air raids on southern Lebanon, violating the ceasefire, with targets including al-Mansouri, Kfar Reman, and other locations. (Source: @presstv/203692)
Israeli Air Force strikes were reported in Kfar B'reshit in southern Lebanon, adding to the pattern of ongoing ceasefire violations. (Source: @yediotnews25/134183)

An enemy Merkava tank fired a shell targeting Wadi al-Mansouri, while continuous and heavy artillery bombardment was reported on the Ali al-Tahir heights. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/386209, @rasedal3ado138e/386233)
Artillery shelling was reported around the Mevdoun area in southern Lebanon, with the source directing followers to a live map for further details. (Source: @redlinkleb/37917)
Israeli artillery fire was reported on the Ali al-Tahir ridge, confirming active bombardment of elevated positions in southern Lebanon. (Source: @New_security8200/203392)

Hezbollah issued a statement slamming the United States as the 'mother of terror' after Washington reinstated sanctions against the group, claiming it is controlled by the IRGC Quds Force. (Source: @presstv/203691)

An Iranian analyst identified as Ali Abdi stated that 'our work in south Lebanon is finished and Peskov is to blame,' suggesting a significant strategic assessment regarding Hezbollah's position in southern Lebanon. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/79600)

Satellite imagery was published showing the condition of a Syrian airfield after Israeli strikes, though the specific airfield name and extent of damage were not detailed in the available message. (Source: @inon_yttach/9900)

Turkey took a first step in response to escalation following a strike in Syria this week. Despite Israeli combat publications, Turkish media and officials have largely downplayed the situation, with reports emphasizing that Erdogan is 'on vacation' and that Turkey does not intend to be drawn into what they perceive as Netanyahu's election game. (Source: @asafroz/52616)

Yemen's Armed Forces released footage of drone strike operations targeting Saudi-backed mercenaries in Marib and along Yemen's western coast, demonstrating continued Houthi military activity. (Source: @presstv/203690)

The UAE has deployed anti-drone structures around its fuel depots, as shown in imagery, indicating heightened defensive preparations against potential aerial threats in the Gulf region. (Source: @kianmeli1/90961)

Trump claimed the US has full control over the Strait of Hormuz and adjacent land areas, stating that Iran's counterparts want to reach a deal but are not yet ready for the right agreement. (Source: @VahidOnline/77992)

The Joint Maritime Information Centre (JMIC) reported a widening of the southern passage of the Strait of Hormuz, enabling simultaneous transit of incoming and outgoing vessels. (Source: @VahidOnline/77985)

Aramco's CEO stated on August 3 that the oil giant continues exports relying on Saudi Arabia's east-west pipeline, the Suez Canal, and the Bab al-Mandab Strait, as Houthi attacks on vessels in Bab al-Mandab have attempted to disrupt energy exports in recent weeks. (Source: @VahidOnline/77985)

An Iranian state media analyst suggested that 'resistance axis' forces should use 'smart sea mines' to mine the Gulf, though the specific reference to Florida appears to be a rhetorical or possibly mistranslated statement. (Source: @VahidOnline/77985)

sections.threat_assessment: The operational tempo across multiple fronts remains high, with Israeli forces conducting targeted eliminations in Gaza and Jenin while simultaneously violating the Lebanon ceasefire through air raids on al-Mansouri, Kfar Reman, and Kfar B'reshit, plus artillery and tank fire on Ali al-Tahir and Wadi al-Mansouri. Iran's leadership is publicly emphasizing continued military buildup and issuing threats against Gulf states constructing alternative pipelines, while an Iranian analyst's claim that 'work in south Lebanon is finished' may signal shifting strategic calculations. The US Pentagon's updated casualty figures of 18 killed and 624 wounded underscore the sustained cost of regional engagements.
sections.regional_response: Turkey is taking initial steps in response to the recent strike in Syria but is deliberately downplaying the situation, with Turkish media framing it as an attempt to avoid being drawn into Netanyahu's electoral politics. The Israeli PM's office fired back, calling Erdogan an antisemitic dictator who massacres Kurds and supports Hamas. Hezbollah's condemnation of new US sanctions as the 'mother of terror' signals continued resistance to Western pressure. The UAE's deployment of anti-drone structures around fuel depots reflects Gulf states' heightened alert posture amid Iran's threats against alternative pipeline routes.
sections.intelligence_notes: The elimination of Fathi Hazem in Jenin is notable because Israeli security officials had previously debated targeting him but refrained due to escalation concerns; his death marks a shift in Israel's willingness to act against high-profile figures in the West Bank. The IDF's strike on Shahtot in Nuseirat during an active ceasefire demonstrates Israel's continued targeting of Hamas operatives involved in October 7. Iran's missile launches toward the Strait of Hormuz and the JMIC report of widened passage suggest ongoing maritime tension. The FBI's reported warning about a possible Iranian drone attack on California indicates the conflict's potential extension beyond the Middle East.
